timing_definition: First recorded execution timestamp through completed audit and verification, immediately before receipt serialization.
tool_call_count_convention: Five functions.exec orchestration calls, each invoking one tools.exec_command; ten invocations if both orchestration and underlying tools are counted.

tool_calls.action: Record UTC start and read PROTOCOL.md, SCOPE.md, packet_a.json, and catalog.json.
Review compact, normalized catalogue and every task after initial display truncation.
Create deterministic audit.py from supplied contract and generate reports_a.json.
Create and run verify_a.py with hand-derived expectations for all reports and four additional contract boundary scenarios.
Compute file hashes and save and validate receipt_a.json.

corrections.description: Initial combined read display was truncated. A compact normalized review recovered all task and catalogue details. No generated report required correction.

checks: All 12 reports in original task order
Exact expected taxa and counts for every valid task
Exact row blockers and original unmet obligations
Float and boolean quantities rejected; duplicate lot ID rejected
Zero dates, zero price, and equal stock demand accepted
Duplicate demand aggregated and overdraw blocks each comparable row
Mismatched units excluded from arithmetic demand
Valid duplicate retains taxon coverage despite a second blocked row
Source host support separated from qualified host supply
Empty proposal retains seasonal and host obligations
Unknown taxon still receives all independent lot blockers
All authority and outcome flags false

limitations: Results use only the supplied finite source-screen contract and catalogue facts.
No protected oracle, answer file, other arm, or existing result was inspected.
